From: Claire Thompson <compliance@clearline.com>

Cc: sec-team@clearline.com
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 / SIG: transport & KMS evidence request — operator access + rotation logs

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG assessment and SOC 2 scoping, we need a short package of artifacts focused on key management and transport encryption for the tenant environment that hosts Clearline data. Requested items below — target turnaround June 30 if possible:

1) KMS/HSM rotation timeline for the last 12 months for tenant KEKs and any cross-tenant wrapping keys (PDF or CSV). Include dates, key_id, old_key_id -> new_key_id, and the reason for rotation.
2) HSM attestation from your vendor (latest vendor-signed PDF).
3) Operator access matrix covering HSM/KMS roles and recent operator changes (who performed rotations, who has unwrap/unwrap privileges). An anonymized matrix is acceptable but please map roles to job functions.
4) KMS audit log extract (last 90 days) showing rotation events, key-usage (encrypt/decrypt/wrap/unwrap), and administrative operations. We prefer a CSV with timestamp, actor, action, key_id, request_id. Redacted PII is fine; please indicate what was redacted.
5) Short description of in-transit encryption configuration: TLS versions/cipher suites used for your customer-facing endpoints and inter-service TLS for KMS calls.

A few clarifying Qs: do you provide raw logs or redacted extracts? Are you able to host a secure S3 link for artifacts?

If June 30 is tight, tell us the earliest sliding timeline and which artifacts can come first.

Regards,
Claire Thompson
Senior Security Analyst — Clearline Financial
compliance@clearline.com

--

Claire —

Thanks again for the list. Attached is the package we discussed; a brief summary is below and the full manifest with checksums is at the S3 link. If you want a live walk-through of the extracts we can schedule a 30-minute call.

Summary of included artifacts (redacted where noted):
- operator-matrix.xlsx (redacted): maps pseudonym -> role -> business title -> last_rotation_performed. Actual operator identities have been replaced with stable pseudonyms (Op01..Op12). A sealed mapping is available under an NDA.
- rotation-timeline.pdf: 12-month timeline of KEK and tenant wrapping key rotations. Includes key_id (redacted suffix), rotation date, initiator_role, and reason category.
- kms-log-extract.csv: 90-day KMS audit extract with rotation events and key-usage entries. Fields: timestamp_utc, event_type, key_id (partial redaction), action_detail, request_id (correlation suffix retained), actor_pseudonym. We included a README (kms-readme.txt) that documents the extraction query and redaction script.
- hsm-attestation.pdf: vendor attestation for our HSM cluster (latest available).

Transfer and verification: artifacts are on a time-limited pre-signed S3 bucket: https://s3.redwood-secure.example/clearline/2029-06/kms-package-3917 (expires 2029-07-05). SHA256 checksums are included in the manifest.

Transport / TLS note: customer-facing endpoints use TLS 1.2+ with a preferred cipher suite list that includes AES-GCM (TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384) and TLS 1.3 (AEAD) for supported clients. Inter-service calls to KMS use mTLS (mutual TLS) with pinned certificates and TLS 1.3 where available. Full cipher-suite list is in the cover letter attachment.

If you need any of the artifacts unredacted for an in-person audit or under a tighter legal agreement, please let us know and we will route through legal.

Best,
Mina
